name: left-on-read
description: Left on Read: a private, in-browser chat analytics experience. Works with WhatsApp chat exports.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/ui/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:fast: vite build && vite build --ssr src/ui/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.bench: rolldown scripts/bench.ts --format esm --platform node --file node_modules/.cache/bench.mjs --log-level silent && node node_modules/.cache/bench.mjs
